title: Sparkly balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="27" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <!-- lighter shade for edge to separate from dark background -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="27" fill="none" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="32" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#ffb3c1" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- small specular highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="28" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#ffe0e6" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <path d="M46 68 Q50 73 54 68 L52 72 L48 72 Z" fill="#ff7a90"/>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d="M50 73 Q47 82 52 88 Q54 91 50 95" fill="none" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <!-- sparkle top left -->
    <path d="M22 18 L24 24 L30 26 L24 28 L22 34 L20 28 L14 26 L20 24 Z"/>
    <!-- sparkle top right -->
    <path d="M78 14 L79.5 19 L84 20.5 L79.5 22 L78 27 L76.5 22 L72 20.5 L76.5 19 Z"/>
    <!-- sparkle right -->
    <path d="M88 42 L89.5 47 L94 48.5 L89.5 50 L88 55 L86.5 50 L82 48.5 L86.5 47 Z"/>
    <!-- sparkle left -->
    <path d="M12 46 L13.5 51 L18 52.5 L13.5 54 L12 59 L10.5 54 L6 52.5 L10.5 51 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- little sparkles / dots, brighter accent -->
  <g fill="#fff59d">
    <circle cx="30" cy="12" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="8" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="34" r="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="84" cy="30" r="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="60" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="26" cy="64" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="78" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="82" r="1.4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny plus sparkles -->
  <g stroke="#ffecb3" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M62 18 L62 26 M58 22 L66 22"/>
    <path d="M28 54 L28 60 M25 57 L31 57"/>
  </g>
</svg>
